cards.title: Growth strong; risk premium rising
cards.question: Is this a rates reset or AI demand failure?
cards.prompt: Nov 13 research drill. Facts: Nov 10 hot CPI; Nov 12 S&P -0.35%, Nasdaq -0.39%, Russell -1.7%, yields rising. 7-day: sharp AI correction and rebound; 30-day: October highs to repricing; 90-day: high-capex AI expansion amid higher financing costs. Hypothesis: discount rates and execution risk, not confirmed end-demand collapse, dominate. Check 2Y/10Y, SOXX vs QQQ and forward estimates; disconfirm if broad revisions fall despite yields stabilizing. https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-fall-nvidia-turmoil-rattles-ai-stocks-2026-11-12/

cards.title: A bounce without breadth is fragile
cards.question: Can the recovery survive weak small caps?
cards.prompt: As of Nov 12: Nasdaq -0.39%, S&P -0.35%, Russell -1.7%; declining issues outnumbered advancers, while energy gained. Nvidia -4.3%, AMD reportedly +5.9%: dispersion is not broad confirmation. Evaluate 7/30-day equal-weight and credit spreads; do not infer trend from one session. Recovery thesis weakens if IWM/RSP lag and credit spreads widen. https://www.reuters.com/business/nasdaq-futures-fall-nvidia-turmoil-rattles-ai-stocks-2026-11-12/

cards.title: Nvidia's roadmap meets succession risk
cards.question: Will the leadership change alter customer choices?
cards.prompt: Verified Nov 12: Nvidia announced CEO transition to interim CEO/CFO Colette Kress. Feb 25 Rubin roadmap promised up to 10x lower inference token cost versus Blackwell; Aug Q2 FY27 revenue $96.2B showed strong demand. Hypothesis: governance and customer concentration could shift share toward AMD/AVGO/custom ASICs; not proof of order migration. Compare Rubin delivery, developer ecosystem, margins, TSMC capacity and AMD wins. Reject share-shift thesis if Nvidia execution and customer retention remain strong. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition/default.aspx https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx

cards.title: Rubin's cost promise needs proof
cards.question: Will February's 10x claim improve customer ROI?
cards.prompt: Dormant catalyst: Nvidia Feb 25 2026 announced Rubin platform and claimed up to 10x reduction in inference token cost relative to Blackwell, with major clouds among initial adopters. Nov 12 succession adds execution uncertainty. The market has priced substantial AI productivity gains; 2027 real-world benchmarks, networking/HBM needs and utilization determine economics. Disconfirm on delays, lower realized savings or weak adoption. Compare Nvidia, TSMC, memory and optical suppliers. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition/default.aspx

cards.title: Nov 17 tests AI guidance and continuity
cards.question: Can Nvidia defend growth after succession?
cards.prompt: Official Nvidia Oct 28 notice confirms Nov 17 2026 Q3 FY27 results ~1:20pm PT and call 2pm PT. Aug outlook Q3 revenue $108B +/-2% and gross margin ~74%; compare reported figures and forward guidance, CEO succession execution, Rubin timing, customer concentration. Bull: resilient orders/margins and credible roadmap; bear: guidance cut, delays or lost orders. Longer 1-12 month catalyst: Nebius delayed third-party capacity into H1 2027; watch actual commissioning, not contracts alone. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Sets-Conference-Call-for-Third-Quarter-Financial-Results/default.aspx https://www.reuters.com/technology/nebius-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-strong-ai-demand-2026-11-12/

cards.title: Contracts are not operating cash flow
cards.question: Will delays hurt builders more than suppliers?
cards.selfCheck: Track MW online and free cash flow.
cards.prompt: Prediction from Nov 13 to Feb 13: if 2027 commissioning lags but hardware orders remain firm, profitable chip/memory/network suppliers should show better earnings revisions than debt-heavy AI builders. Nov 10 CoreWeave $132.5B backlog and >4.6GW contracted vs >1.7GW active; Nov 12 Nebius lowered 2026 forecast on third-party capacity delays. The market already recognizes strong AI demand; key uncertainty is time-to-cash and financing. Reject if supplier orders cut, operators rapidly improve cash flow, or deployment catches up. Compare MU, TSMC, COHR/LITE, CRWV, NBIS. https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx https://www.reuters.com/technology/nebius-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-strong-ai-demand-2026-11-12/
